name: Brain Coral
flavor: A massive Brain Coral materializes, its labyrinthine grooves pulsing with ancient thought.

name: Staghorn Coral
flavor: A thicket of Staghorn Coral branches upward, its antler-like arms forming a jagged barrier.

name: Fire Coral
flavor: A formation of Fire Coral erupts, its deceptively smooth surface burning with venomous intent.

name: Elkhorn Coral
flavor: Broad plates of Elkhorn Coral fan outward, creating a living shield of calcium and will.

name: Pillar Coral
flavor: A column of Pillar Coral rises like a marble pillar, its surface dotted with extended polyps.

name: Table Coral
flavor: A wide Table Coral spreads horizontally, its flat canopy providing shelter like a stone parasol.

name: Bubble Coral
flavor: Clusters of Bubble Coral inflate into being, their translucent vesicles catching and bending light.

name: Organ Pipe Coral
flavor: An Organ Pipe Coral rises in crimson tubes, humming a low resonance like a submerged cathedral.

name: Sea Fan
flavor: A delicate Sea Fan unfurls, its intricate lattice swaying as though moved by invisible currents.

name: Star Coral
flavor: A formation of Star Coral blooms, each polyp opening like a tiny constellation on stone.

name: Mushroom Coral
flavor: A solitary Mushroom Coral appears, its disc-shaped body resting on the ground like a living shield.

name: Lettuce Coral
flavor: Ruffled sheets of Lettuce Coral ripple into existence, their folded edges sharp enough to cut.

name: Cup Coral
flavor: A cluster of Cup Coral crystallizes, each tiny chalice glowing with bioluminescent light.

name: Black Coral
flavor: A twisted spire of Black Coral emerges, its dark skeleton radiating an aura of deep-sea dread.

name: Blue Coral
flavor: A formation of Blue Coral hardens into place, its cerulean skeleton gleaming with oceanic power.

name: Flower Coral
flavor: Delicate Flower Coral blooms, each polyp unfurling like a tiny underwater blossom.

name: Horn Coral
flavor: A curved Horn Coral rises, its spiraling form echoing the shape of an ancient war horn.

name: Whip Coral
flavor: A long strand of Whip Coral lashes into being, its flexible form swaying with menacing reach.

name: Lace Coral
flavor: An intricate Lace Coral spreads its delicate filigree, beautiful and brittle as frozen breath.

name: Tube Coral
flavor: A cluster of Tube Coral extends upward, their hollow forms whistling as air moves through them.

name: Boulder Coral
flavor: A massive Boulder Coral slams into existence, its rounded bulk as heavy and immovable as stone.

name: Sunflower Coral
flavor: A radiant Sunflower Coral opens wide, its ring of tentacles reaching out like golden rays.

name: Cabbage Coral
flavor: Thick folds of Cabbage Coral layer into being, each leafy plate overlapping in armored tiers.

name: Wire Coral
flavor: A single strand of Wire Coral extends impossibly far, thin as thread yet strong as steel cable.

name: Carnation Coral
flavor: A vibrant Carnation Coral blooms in pinks and purples, its soft body masking surprising resilience.

name: Needle Coral
flavor: A bristling Needle Coral erupts, its thin spines jutting outward like a sea urchin's warning.

name: Maze Coral
flavor: A Maze Coral forms with winding valleys and ridges, its surface an impossible puzzle in stone.

name: Plate Coral
flavor: A broad Plate Coral extends like a hovering disc, its thin edge slicing through the air.

name: Finger Coral
flavor: Stubby digits of Finger Coral reach upward, grasping at the sky like a drowned hand.

name: Scroll Coral
flavor: A Scroll Coral curls into being, its rolled edges resembling an ancient parchment turned to stone.

name: Cactus Coral
flavor: A Cactus Coral bristles into existence, its bumpy surface and thick branches defying any approach.

name: Ivory Coral
flavor: A pristine Ivory Coral rises, its bone-white branches gleaming with an unsettling perfection.

name: Pipeorgan Coral
flavor: A crimson Pipeorgan Coral grows in parallel tubes, each one resonating with a different harmonic tone.

name: Galaxea Coral
flavor: A Galaxea Coral sparkles into being, its elongated tentacles sweeping outward like tiny comet tails.

name: Torch Coral
flavor: A Torch Coral ignites with bioluminescent tips, its swaying tentacles casting an eerie glow.

name: Hammer Coral
flavor: A Hammer Coral extends its T-shaped polyps, each one swinging gently like a weighted pendulum.

name: Frogspawn Coral
flavor: A Frogspawn Coral bubbles into being, its bulbous tips clustering like strange amphibian eggs.

name: Sun Coral
flavor: A brilliant Sun Coral opens in vivid orange, its polyps radiating warmth in defiance of the deep.

name: Abyss Coral
flavor: An Abyss Coral surges from darkness, its obsidian branches drinking in all surrounding light.

name: Stormcoral
flavor: A crackling Stormcoral crystallizes, arcs of static leaping between its charged mineral branches.

name: Bloodreef
flavor: A Bloodreef formation oozes into place, its crimson mass pulsing with an unsettling heartbeat.

name: Ghostcoral
flavor: A translucent Ghostcoral shimmers into being, its bleached form flickering between solid and spectral.

name: Ironreef
flavor: An Ironreef colony hardens with a metallic ring, its ferrous skeleton stronger than forged plate.

name: Voidcoral
flavor: A Voidcoral formation appears as a gap in reality, its surface showing only endless dark water.

name: Prismcoral
flavor: A dazzling Prismcoral refracts light into a thousand colors, each branch a living rainbow.
